OpenHyTest is a Python toolbox for hydraulic test interpretation. It provides preprocessing utilities, analytical well-test models, nonlinear fitting, diagnostic plots, and report generation for pumping, interference, multirate, double-porosity, generalized radial flow, and slug-test analyses.

The package is a work in progress.
